scripts.text: To get these missions, I need to Join the Eden Group first. I must find Secretary Lime Evenor and become a member.
scripts.translation: 要接取这些任务，我需要先加入乐园团。我必须找到秘书 莱姆·艾弗诺并成为成员。

scripts.text: Here is the list of various adventures for level 56~70 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 这是56~70级冒险者的各种冒险任务列表。

scripts.text: Lots of missions such as a Monster Hunting, Delivery Goods, Finding People.
scripts.translation: 有很多任务，比如讨伐魔物、运送货物、寻找人物等。

scripts.text: Mission Numbers 1~5
scripts.translation: 任务编号 1~5

scripts.text: Mission Numbers 6~10
scripts.translation: 任务编号 6~10

scripts.translation: 这是什么绷带？

scripts.translation: 危险的鳄鱼人

scripts.text: That wasn't a mermaid...
scripts.translation: 那不是美人鱼...

scripts.text: My country is calling me!
scripts.translation: 我的祖国在呼唤我！

scripts.text: Hunt Wild Boar
scripts.translation: 讨伐野猪

scripts.text: Preparing the Summer
scripts.translation: 准备夏天

scripts.text: A Woman's Grudge
scripts.translation: 女子的怨恨

scripts.text: Special ingredients
scripts.translation: 特殊食材

scripts.translation: 傀儡师的痛苦

scripts.translation: 烦人的苍蝇

scripts.text: Dangerous Munak
scripts.translation: 危险的僵尸

scripts.text: Make the World green
scripts.translation: 让世界变绿

scripts.text: Magic Wand
scripts.translation: 魔法棒

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by the Rekenber corporation from Lighthalzen. Below are the details.
scripts.translation: 此任务由里希塔乐镇的雷肯贝尔公司指派。以下是详细信息。

scripts.text: Rekenber corporation is about to launch a new project called 'Green Medical Center'. For the first product of the project, we are preparing well-being Bandages.
scripts.translation: 雷肯贝尔公司即将启动一个名为“绿色医疗中心”的新项目。作为该项目的第一个产品，我们正在准备健康绷带。

scripts.text: Regarding the project, we need to research monster's reactions when they are wrapped with Rotten Bandages.
scripts.translation: 关于该项目，我们需要研究魔物被腐烂绷带包裹时的反应。

scripts.text: If you are interested, please hunt 30 Mummies and bring 30 Rotten Bandages. You can find them in the Pyramid West of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 如果您感兴趣，请猎杀30只木乃伊并带回30个腐烂绷带。您可以在莫洛克的金字塔西部找到它们。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: - Rekenber corporation chief director 'Julie E Delph' -
scripts.translation: - 雷肯贝尔公司首席总监“朱莉·E·德尔菲” -

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by the Comodo cooperative society. Below are the details.
scripts.translation: 此任务由克魔岛合作社指派。以下是详细信息。

scripts.text: Alligators have gone wild these days, they attack women and drunken people who hang out near the beach.
scripts.translation: 最近鳄鱼人变得很疯狂，它们袭击在海滩附近闲逛的女性和醉酒的人。

scripts.text: This is a very shameful situation for us, the most wonderful vacation spot in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 这对我们来说是一个非常丢脸的情况，我们是卢恩·米德加兹最棒的度假胜地。

scripts.text: So, it would be very helpful if you hunt 30 Alligators to clean out this situation.
scripts.translation: 因此，如果您能猎杀30只鳄鱼人来清理这种情况，那将非常有帮助。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by an unknown client from Izlude.
scripts.translation: 此任务由来自依斯鲁得岛的一位神秘委托人指派。

scripts.text: I have admired the beach of Izlude, ever since I was born.
scripts.translation: 自从我出生起，就一直向往着依斯鲁得岛的海滩。

scripts.text: When I was young, I found a mysterious creature in the Izlude dungeon, I had never seen something like that before...
scripts.translation: 小时候，我在依斯鲁得岛的迷宫中发现了一种神秘的生物，那是我从未见过的...

scripts.text: I instantly thought it was a mermaid. I was so supprised, I have studied about mermaids in whole my life.
scripts.translation: 我立刻认为那是美人鱼。我惊讶极了，因为我一生都在研究美人鱼。

scripts.text: But, as I studied harder, I found that the creature was not a mermaid... yes, It wasn't beautiful at all like other mermaids...
scripts.translation: 但随着研究的深入，我发现那并不是美人鱼...是的，它完全不像其他美人鱼那样美丽...

scripts.text: I finally tracked down the fact that it was a Merman, not a Mermaid!
scripts.translation: 我终于查明真相，那是人鱼士兵，而不是美人鱼！

scripts.text: Merman... I have wasted my life studying this monster! So please hunt 30 Mermans to make me feel better.
scripts.translation: 人鱼士兵...我竟然浪费了一生去研究这种魔物！请帮我猎杀30只人鱼士兵，让我好受一点。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Izlude 'The Lost dream mermaid' --
scripts.translation: -- 依斯鲁得岛 “失落梦想的美人鱼” --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by the government officer of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 此任务由卢恩·米德加兹王国的政府军官指派。

scripts.text: To prevent a flood in Prontera, we decided to build a huge dam to regulate the water supply.
scripts.translation: 为了防止普隆德拉发生洪水，我们决定建造一座巨大的水坝来调节供水。

scripts.text: But, we are shorthanded on supplies and we need to collect Fine Sand and Grit.
scripts.translation: 但是，我们的物资短缺，需要收集黄晶沙和砂砾。

scripts.text: So, we would like to ask for help. People, please bring us 10 Fine Sand and 30 Grit each so we can build the dam.
scripts.translation: 因此，我们请求大家的帮助。请每人带来10个黄晶沙和30个砂砾，以便我们建造水坝。

scripts.text: You can get those materials from Sand Man, I wish you good luck!
scripts.translation: 你可以从沙人那里获得这些材料，祝你好运！

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Government officer of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Dufre Kent --
scripts.translation: -- 卢恩·米德加兹王国政府军官，杜夫雷·肯特 --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by the Payon town hall.
scripts.translation: 此任务由斐扬镇公所指派。

scripts.text: Wild animals are always annoyances to farmers.
scripts.translation: 野生动物总是让农民们头疼。

scripts.text: They attack our farm and ruin whole crops!! We can't stand it anymore!
scripts.translation: 它们袭击我们的农田，毁坏了整片庄稼！！我们再也无法忍受了！

scripts.text: So, we would like to ask for the help from brave adventurers.
scripts.translation: 因此，我们请求勇敢的冒险者伸出援手。

scripts.text: Please, hunt 30 Savages to save our crops!
scripts.translation: 请猎杀30只野猪，拯救我们的庄稼！

scripts.text: You can easily find those monsters around our town and field.
scripts.translation: 你可以在我们城镇和田野附近轻松找到这些魔物。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Payon town hall members --
scripts.translation: -- 斐扬 城镇 成员 --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by the Morocc blacksmith Aragham.
scripts.translation: 该任务由莫洛克的铁匠阿拉甘发布。

scripts.text: Hello~~~~, Adventurers! This is Aragham, the hottest blacksmith in Morocc!
scripts.translation: 你好~~~~，冒险者们！我是莫洛克最酷的铁匠阿拉甘！

scripts.text: Anyway, I have a son named Aragam Junior, the cute one. Haha.
scripts.translation: 总之，我有个儿子叫阿拉甘·朱尼尔，是个很可爱的孩子。哈哈。

scripts.text: He will be attending summer camp this summer, but he doesn't know how to swim.
scripts.translation: 他今年夏天要去参加夏令营，但他不会游泳。

scripts.text: I want to teach him, but as you know I am a blacksmith, a far cry from swimming! Hehe.
scripts.translation: 我想教他，但你知道的，我是个铁匠，跟游泳差得远呢！嘿嘿。

scripts.text: But, I figured that if I make swim fins, it will be great for his confidence~!
scripts.translation: 不过，我想如果我给他做一副游泳蹼，对他建立自信会有很大帮助~！

scripts.text: To make it, I need 30 Sticky Webfoots from a Roda Frog. Can you bring them to me?
scripts.translation: 制作它需要30个罗达蛙的粘糊的蹼。你能带给我吗？

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: PS. Do not compare me with Hollgrehenn or Antonio!!!!
scripts.translation: P.S. 请不要把我跟霍尔格雷恩或安东尼奥相提并论!!!!

scripts.text: -- The hottest blacksmith, Morocc blacksmith Aragham --
scripts.translation: -- 莫洛克最酷的铁匠 阿拉甘 --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by an inventor Dorian from Izlude.
scripts.translation: 该任务由依斯鲁得岛的发明家多里安发布。

scripts.text: Have you heard the story that if women have a grudge on their mind, it will bring natural disasters.
scripts.translation: 你听说过那个故事吗？如果女人心里怀有怨恨，就会引发自然灾害。

scripts.text: Wow, so guys must watch out for those sensitive women! Make sure they don't have any grudges on you.
scripts.translation: 哇，所以男生们必须小心那些敏感的女人！确保她们对你没有怨恨。

scripts.text: Women can bring strange phenomenons with them!
scripts.translation: 女人能带来奇怪的现象！

scripts.text: I am so intrigued with that story that I'm trying to prove that it can be true.
scripts.translation: 我对那个故事非常着迷，所以我正在试图证明它是真的。

scripts.text: So I need to make women upset! Haha, I know what a mean idea, right?
scripts.translation: 所以我需要让女人感到生气！哈哈，我知道这主意很坏，对吧？

scripts.text: But this is seriously just for studying... So please hunt 30 Sohee's who seems to be revived from victimized souls.
scripts.translation: 但这真的只是为了研究... 所以请去猎杀30只鬼女，她们似乎是被冤屈的灵魂复活的。

scripts.text: So I can keep observing the case.
scripts.translation: 这样我就可以继续观察这个案例了。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Elegance inventor Dorian --
scripts.translation: -- 优雅的发明家 多里安 --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by Wallah from Payon.
scripts.translation: 该任务由斐扬的瓦拉发布。

scripts.text: Hello, adventurer. How are you? How is your health?
scripts.translation: 你好，冒险者。你好吗？身体怎么样？

scripts.text: I am a pharmacist and I am having a hard time getting special ingredients lately.
scripts.translation: 我是一名药剂师，最近很难买到特殊的原料。

scripts.text: Because I am a little sensitive girl, how can I possibly get those things by myself.
scripts.translation: 因为我是一个有点敏感的女孩，怎么可能自己去弄那些东西呢。

scripts.text: So, please help me. Just bring 40 Huge Leafs to me, that will be enough to complete my special medicine!
scripts.translation: 所以，请帮帮我。只要给我40个巨大叶子，就足够完成我的特殊药物了！

scripts.text: Please bring it as soon as possible, people need my medicine.
scripts.translation: 请尽快带来，人们需要我的药。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Wallah --
This mission is assigned by puppet master Woonute from Geffen.
scripts.translation: 该任务由吉芬的傀儡师 Woonute 发布。

scripts.text: You know being a puppet master is kind of a hard job to satisfy people.
scripts.translation: 你知道，作为傀儡师，要让人满意其实挺难的。

scripts.text: People can search and see so many different things on their own thesedays.
scripts.translation: 现在人们可以自己去搜索和发现很多不同的东西。

scripts.text: Their expectations are getting high, I can't satisfy them anymore.
scripts.translation: 他们的期望越来越高，我再也无法满足他们了。

scripts.text: But if I can make new toy concepts, like living toys, it will be ground breaking.
scripts.translation: 但如果我能创造出新的玩具概念，比如会动的玩具，那将是划时代的。

scripts.text: I heard that there are live dolls called Marionettes. Can you hunt 30 Marionettes for me? And also bring 30 Golden Hair, those will be great materials for the new toys.
scripts.translation: 我听说有一种叫傀儡娃娃的活体玩偶。你能帮我猎杀30只傀儡娃娃吗？另外再带30个金色头发，它们会是制作新玩具的绝佳材料。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Puppet Master Woonute --
scripts.translation: -- 傀儡师 Woonute --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by an exterminator from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 该任务由普隆德拉的除虫师发布。

scripts.text: As the weather gets warmer, insects multiply more and more. It is already out of control.
scripts.translation: 随着天气变暖，昆虫越来越多。情况已经失控了。

scripts.text: People in Prontera cannot sleep because of all the bugs in their house.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉的人们因为家里全是虫子而无法入睡。

scripts.text: So, please help us, hunt 30 Hunter Flies. Then the flies can be reduced slowly.
scripts.translation: 所以，请帮帮我们，猎杀30只猎人苍蝇。这样苍蝇的数量就能慢慢减少了。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- The Prontera exterminator --
scripts.translation: -- 普隆德拉的除虫师 --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by Cheese Dongja from Payon.
scripts.translation: 该任务由斐扬的芝士东佳发布。

scripts.text: Have you heard about Munak?
scripts.translation: 你听说过僵尸吗？

scripts.text: The ugly monster Munak is threatening people in Payon.
scripts.translation: 丑陋的僵尸正在威胁斐扬的居民。

scripts.text: So we need brave adventurers like you!
scripts.translation: 所以我们需要像你这样勇敢的冒险者！

scripts.text: Please hunt 30 Munaks then Payon will be in peace.
scripts.translation: 请猎杀30只僵尸，这样斐扬就能恢复和平了。

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: - Payon Cheese Dongja -
scripts.translation: - 斐扬的芝士东佳 -

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by a gem dealer, Ibraham from Morocc.
scripts.translation: 该任务由莫洛克的宝石商人伊布拉欣发布。

scripts.text: A small beautiful flower in the barren desert... What an incredible scene it would be!
scripts.translation: 荒芜沙漠中的一朵美丽小花...那该是多么不可思议的景象啊！

scripts.text: Planting flowers can make the world green and it will be so pretty everywhere.
scripts.translation: 种花能让世界变绿，到处都会变得非常美丽。

scripts.text: I plan to plant strong flowers in the Morocc desert so the soil gets better.
scripts.translation: 我计划在莫洛克沙漠种植强壮的花朵，以改良土壤。

scripts.text: I need 40 Maneater Blossom from Flora, I know Maneater Blossom is an ugly flower, but still it is a plant.
scripts.translation: 我需要从芙罗拉那里获得40朵噬人树花。我知道噬人树花是一种丑陋的花，但它毕竟也是植物。

scripts.text: I hope you can hunt Flora and get me 40 Maneater Blossoms. You are making the world green! Be proud!
scripts.translation: 希望你能猎杀芙罗拉，为我收集40朵噬人树花。你正在让世界变绿！为此感到自豪吧！

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Morocc Ibraham --
scripts.translation: -- 莫洛克的伊布拉欣 --

scripts.text: This mission is assigned by the Payon blacksmith Antonio.
scripts.translation: 该任务由斐扬的铁匠安东尼奥发布。

scripts.text: Magic wand! Have you heard about it? It is an incredible wand!
scripts.translation: 魔法棒！你听说过吗？那是一根不可思议的魔杖！

scripts.text: If you say the magic words and swing the wand, it will make your wishes come true.
scripts.translation: 只要念出咒语并挥动魔杖，你的愿望就会成真。

scripts.text: So, I decided to make it by myself. Then I will be rich and powerful~! Haha!!
scripts.translation: 所以，我决定自己制作一根。那样我就能变得富有且强大~！哈哈！！

scripts.text: To make the wand, I need some special materials.
scripts.translation: 要制作魔杖，我需要一些特殊的材料。

scripts.text: Please bring me 30 Dokebi Horns and 30 Trunks. If you do so, I will lend you my magic wand once. Haha, good deal?
scripts.translation: 请给我带来30个土人之角和30个树干。如果你做到了，我会借给你我的魔法棒一次。哈哈，这笔交易很划算吧？

scripts.text: Please confirm it to us after you complete the mission, then we will give you proper rewards.
scripts.translation: 请在完成任务后向我们确认，然后我们将给予您适当的奖励。

scripts.text: -- Payon blacksmith Antonio --
scripts.translation: -- 斐扬的铁匠安东尼奥 --
